scope: Fresh local worker journeys; running task and review patch use explicit browser fixtures; protocol smoke uses a local executable fixture. No live providers.

checks: dedicated unlock, invalid token, reload retains session
definition preview/adaptation, task snapshot, queue, draft while busy, same-session follow-up, escaped HTML, code copy
restart relocks, transcript/profile persists, unsent draft restored
explicit lock revokes saved browser access

limitations: Desktop Chromium viewport emulation; software keyboard and assistive technology were not tested.
